description: Second hand: prepare (unsigned) putting your apartment or vehicle up for sale for $ZENI. Returns nftApproval (send it first when needed) and the listing transaction. 5% fee comes out of the sale. An apartment's safe goes to the buyer: withdraw it first, or say the most you accept to leave (maxSafeZeni; default 5% of a new one's price). Listing again changes the price.

id.description: The apartment id or vehicle id

priceZeni.description: Asking price in ZENI, for example "9000"

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read holdings and to simulate.

name: prepare_resale_list
